subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when native open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: Current source proves the open_id-only bug path, but the active union_id PR relies on an identity field the reporter says bot/v3/info does not return, so automation should not choose the permanent Feishu identity contract.

options.title: Rewrite Around A Proven Identity
options.body: Validate a stable Feishu bot identity source, rebuild the fix on current main, and cover every mention admission path before merge.

options.title: Document A Platform Limitation
options.body: If Feishu exposes no reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Identity Work
options.body: Handle this together with broader Feishu multi-bot session and identity design only if maintainers want one shared model for admission and routing.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around A Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Validate a stable Feishu bot identity source, rebuild the fix on current main, and cover every mention admission path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing signal from recent Feishu-area work and the active fix candidate's review context.
